'''''Sleemo Poya Jeedai''''' was a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]-owned [[Yacht/Legends|yacht]]. Its name roughly translated as "The Drooling Jedi". It once traveled to [[Aquella Firth]]'s home system, where the band [[Distraction]] were scheduled to perform aboard it. During the concert, [[Niklas Cories]] attempted to [[Death/Legends|kill]] the crowd and damage the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] by throwing a [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonator]].
